description: The restaurant's published menu: sections, dishes, prices, dietary labels and allergens exactly as the restaurant lists them. Optional text or dietary filter. Returns item_id values for get_order_link.

dietary.description: Only dishes with this dietary label, e.g. "vegan", "vegetarian", "gluten".

restaurant_id.description: The restaurant_id returned by search_restaurants (for example "oak-nosh").

search.description: Only dishes whose name or description contains this text.

name: get_menu
title: Menu
